left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Bins were not pulled toward the nominal or a neighbor. (1,8) keeps B=-0.090990 rather than the nominal B=-0.125191 because the points support the smaller modulation. 4 bins still have a cos(2phi) or cos(phi) error that collapses because the second pass lands on an amplitude near zero. The free cosine does not change those shapes, so the limits were not opened. The collapsed errors are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and they are not added to the systematic budget.
